'''Paul Gustav Heinrich Bachmann''' (22 June 1837 – 31 March 1920) was a German [[mathematician]].

==Life==
Bachmann studied [[mathematics]] at the university of his native city of [[Berlin]] and received his doctorate in 1862 for his thesis on [[group theory]].  He then went to [[Breslau]] to study for his habilitation, which he received in 1864 for his thesis on [[Complex Unit]]s. He was a professor at [[Breslau]] and later at [[Münster]].<ref>{{MacTutor Biography | id=Bachmann | title=Paul Gustav Heinrich Bachmann}}</ref>

==Works==
*''Zahlentheorie'', Bachmann's work on [[number theory]] in five volumes (1872-1923):
**Vol. I: ''[https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/bpt6k99474n Die Elemente der Zahlentheorie]'' (1892)<ref>{{cite journal|author=Young, Jacob William Albert|title=Review: ''Die Elemente der Zahlentheorie'', by P. Bachmann|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1894|volume=3|issue=9|pages=215–222|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1894-03-09/S0002-9904-1894-00216-X/|doi=10.1090/s0002-9904-1894-00216-x|doi-access=free}}</ref>
**Vol. II: ''[https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/bpt6k994750 Analytische Zahlentheorie]'' (1894), a work on [[analytic number theory]] in which [[Big O notation]] was first introduced
**Vol. III: ''[https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/bpt6k99483m Die Lehre von der Kreistheilung und ihre Beziehungen zur Zahlentheorie]'' (first published in 1872)
**Vol. IV (Part 1): ''[https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/bpt6k994828 Die Arithmetik der quadratischen Formen]'' (1898)
**Vol. IV (Part 2): ''[https://archive.org/details/arithdquadrachen02bachrich Die Arithmetik der quadratischen Formen]'' (posthumously published in 1923)
**Vol. V: ''[https://gallica.bnf.fr/ark:/12148/bpt6k99483m Allgemeine Arithmetik der Zahlenkörper]'' (1905)
*''Niedere Zahlentheorie'': [https://archive.org/details/nederezahlenthe01bachrich First part] (1902), [https://archive.org/details/nederezahlenthe02bachrich Second part] (1910),<ref>{{cite journal|author=Dickson, L. E.|authorlink=Leonard Eugene Dickson|title=Review: ''Niedere Zahlentheorie. Erster Teil'', by P. Bachmann|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1903|volume=9|issue=10|pages=555–556|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1903-09-10/S0002-9904-1903-01031-3/|doi=10.1090/s0002-9904-1903-01031-3|doi-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|author=Dickson, L. E.|title=Review: ''Niedere Zahlentheorie. Zweiter Teil'', by P. Bachmann|journal=Bull. Amer. Math. Soc.|year=1911|volume=17|issue=5|pages=255–256|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/bull/1911-17-05/S0002-9904-1911-02041-9/|doi=10.1090/s0002-9904-1911-02041-9|doi-access=free}}</ref> a two-volume work on elementary [[number theory]]
*''Das Fermat-Problem in seiner bisherigen Entwicklung'', a work about [[Fermat's Last Theorem]]

Bachmann introduced the [[Big O notation]], which was later popularized by [[Edmund Landau]].
